check.description: Result of the timeliness check reported in the ThinLayer M&C log line (e.g. OK)

day.description: Day of the month parsed from the log timestamp

env.description: Processing environment flag from the ThinLayer log (e.g. N for nominal)

eventname.description: Name of the logged event (e.g. LOPP)

eventtime.description: Timestamp of the event as reported in the ThinLayer log line

filename.description: Name of the L0PP granule product referenced by the log line

generationtime.description: Generation time of the product reported in the log line

hostname.description: Host name of the S3P station server that emitted the log line

level.description: Product processing level from the log line (e.g. 0)

ptype.description: Product type code from the log line

message.description: Free-text message field of the log line

month.description: Month parsed from the log timestamp

pid.description: Process identifier of the ThinLayer agent from the log line

pmode.description: Processing mode from the log line (e.g. N for nominal)

process.description: Name of the process or agent that emitted the log line

reftime.description: Reference time source of the product (e.g. ground)

log_date.description: Date the log line was emitted, used as the monthly partition field

reportName.description: Identifier of the source report or log file the record was extracted from

sat.description: Satellite unit the log line refers to (e.g. S3A)

time.description: Time component parsed from the log timestamp

timelinessKey.description: Downlink session timeliness key that identifies the S3P session

validitystart.description: Start of the product validity period from the log line

validitystop.description: Stop of the product validity period from the log line
